scientific_integrity: Deterministic matrix analysis derived independently from the three explicitly printed payoff matrices; exact rational polynomial identities replayed with the included Python checker. The input matrices and standard strict-stability Lyapunov technique are attributed to their sources. No human or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The payoff paths are affine mathematical interpolations, not empirical pH or drug-response calibrations; only interior initial states and fixed environments are covered; stochastic, evolutionary and clinical conclusions do not follow. Absolute originality beyond the inspected sources has not been proven.
title: Two sharp phenotype-extinction switches along pH payoff paths in a four-strategy tumor game
